question: ‘281 and beyond’ is the autobiography of which veteran cricketer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**VVS Laxman.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A stylish batsman who could score against any kind of bowling, **VVS Laxman** played over a hundred Tests to aggregate more than **8,000 runs**.
 
• Cricket fans still remember with awe his game-changing **knock of 281 against Australia in 2001 at Eden Gardens.**
 
• **Vangipurapu Venkata Sai Laxman **is a former Indian international cricketer and a former cricket commentator and pundit.
 
• A **right-hand batsman** known for his elegant stroke play, Laxman played as a middle-order batsman in Test cricket.
 
• He was born on 1 November **1974**.
 
• Book: **281 AND BEYOND** Author: **VVS Laxman with R Kaushik Publisher: Westland Sport.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Test of My Life is the biography of Yuvraj Singh.
 
• Playing It My Way is the autobiography of Sachin Tendulkar.
 
• **Muhammad Ali** is a boxer. His book's name is **''His Life and Times".**
 
• **Suresh Raina'**s autobiography, titled **"Believe – What Life and Cricket Taught Me"**
 
• **Virat Kohli **: **Driven: The Virat Kohli Story**
